$comment: P69 round 4 (lane `lm`, D-FFI-DESCRIPTOR-VOCABULARY-TAG-RESIDUALS items (d) and (h)): the C library's `long` functions carry the TYPE `long`, not only its width. At compile time, on every target: `labs`, `atol`, `strtol`, `strtoul`, `ftell` and `fseek` by their designators (`_Generic` over the function: `long (*)(long)` and so on) and by a call (the result type), with `ldiv`, `llabs` and `abs` as the controls that were always right; on Windows `ExitThread`, `Sleep`, `GetLastError` and `GetCurrentThreadId` over DWORD, which is `unsigned long`. At run time: `labs` of a value whose magnitude needs every bit of `long` (the width, which was already right), the same call through a `long (*)(long)`, objects declared `typeof (call)` reached through `long *` / `unsigned long *`, and the conversions at the edge of 32 bits; on Windows a thread leaving through <threads.h>'s `thrd_exit` (which the compiler builds over kernel32's `ExitThread`) and one leaving through the header's own `ExitThread`, each joined for its code (7 and 9), the header's `Sleep` beside `thrd_sleep`, and `GetLastError` / `Sleep` held by pointers over `unsigned long`. Each check returns its own code; 42 = all held. MEASURED on the references (this file, exit 42): MSVC 19.51 at /Od and /O2 (run 20261008-053703-6cd2baed), gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3 and aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -static at -O0 and -O2 (run 20261008-053721-ce5d4122), native aarch64 gcc 13.3.0 (run 20261008-053838-ed83f91a), Apple clang 21 on both Mach-O arches at -O0 and -O2 (run 20261008-053813-c0817592). mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 ships no <threads.h>, so the whole file's pe reference is MSVC; the identities themselves were measured on mingw-w64 too (run 20261008-050017-91422066). Before the tags DSS refused the file on every target at its first assertion (`labs is long (long)`): the descriptors wrote these positions as anonymous cores, `int` on LLP64 and a type that is neither `long` nor `long long` on LP64. The unit pin is tests/ffi/test_shipped_lib_descriptor.cpp (`ShippedLongPositionsTakeThePairsDataModelArm`, `ShippedDwordPositionsAreUnsignedLong`).
